items.information: Dette er den første konkurrence arrangeret af foreningen Speedcubing Aarhus. Udover WCA-discipliner afholder vi også 2 FunCubing-discipliner: 3x3x3 Team-Blind og 3x3x3 Med Grillhandsker. Vi tilbyder billig [overnatning](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/AarhusChristmas2019#12737-overnatning-accommodation). Forældre er velkomne til at byde ind, hvis de gerne vil lave en praktisk opgave under konkurrencen. Send en mail til: speedcubingaarhus@googlegroups.com ______ This is the first competition organized by Speedcubing Aarhus. In addition to the WCA events, there will also be 2 FunCubing events: 3x3x3 Team-Blind and 3x3x3 With Oven Mitts. We offer cheap [accommodation](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/AarhusChristmas2019#12737-overnatning-accommodation). If they would like to, parents are very welcome to lend us a hand during the competition. Please mail: speedcubingaarhus@googlegroups.com

items.name: Tirol Open 2019

venue.name: Bischöfliches Gymnasium Paulinum
venue.address: Paulinumweg 1, 6130 Schwaz

items.information: 2019 ist das Jahr in dem Speedcubing Competitions den Westen Österreichs erreichen. Nach Vorarlberg gibt es nun auch eine in Tirol! Durch Tirol zieht sich ein langes Tal, das Inntal, welches das breiteste Tal in Tirol ist, für erste Besucher aber trotzdem eng erscheinen könnte. Das Organisationsteam organisiert auch Räume in einer Jugendherberge im Nachbargebäude. Bei Interesse, wirf bitte eine Blick in den Travel/Accomodation Tab! ______ 2019 is the year that Competitions start spreading to the west of Austria. After Vorarlberg, we are happy to announce the first ever Competition in Tirol! Tirol is entirely mountainous with one big valley (the Inn Valley) stretching its entire length. This valley is big for tyrolean standards but for first-time visitors it might just seem tight as well. The organisation team is also organising Rooms in a youth hostel next door. If you are interested in this, take a look at the Travel/Accomodation tab!
